title: RAVIT — Mont-Blanc TDS 2026 race analysis
claims: RAVIT's timing analysis records 1,285 starters and a 44.4% DNF rate for TDS 2026, with 23 timing points.

The median dropout point is km 66.09; Beaufort accounts for 137 dropouts, Cormet de Roselend 103, Bourg-Saint-Maurice 76, La Gittaz 56, Fort de la Platte 36, Lac Combal 34, Petit-Saint-Bernard 25 and Hauteluce 22.
RAVIT is a third-party timing-analysis site, not the race organiser; its counts may differ from the official result list.
